title: Randomization Without Constraints
constraints: After every `randomize()` call, `perm` holds a random permutation of 0 … 9.
**Not allowed:** `constraint` blocks, `randc`, `dist`, `unique` (the judge rejects them). Find another way.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: `post_randomize()` runs after every successful `randomize()` call. You can compute anything there.
Alternatively implement a Fisher–Yates shuffle with `$urandom_range`.

examples.check: every value appears in the first position
examples.title: uniformity
examples.expected: every value leads at least once

forbidden.message: no constraint blocks, randc, dist or unique in this problem
